about.title: About
about.content: I'm Fatima Zahra, a full-stack developer from Morocco specializing in web development and artificial intelligence. I build modern, responsive web applications from frontend to backend and integrate AI and machine learning features. Passionate about clean design and user experience, I love turning ideas into functional, elegant products.

items.position: Software Development Intern, Tanger Med Port Authority (TMPA) - Tangier, Morocco
description: Developed a reusable real-time support chat module for integration into TMPA applications.
Built role-based client, agent, and admin workflows with JWT authentication and conversation management.
Implemented real-time messaging using Socket.IO and developed REST APIs with Node.js and Express.js.
Worked with React, MongoDB, Mongoose, Docker, and Docker Compose.
Developed multiple web applications, including a weather application, user management system, task manager, and e-commerce platform.
Built responsive interfaces and full-stack features using modern JavaScript technologies.
Worked with APIs, authentication, databases, CRUD operations, and Git-based workflows.

items.position: Web Developer, Euroweb Digital - Tangier, Morocco
description: Developed and customized responsive websites and e-commerce solutions using WordPress and Divi.
Implemented client requirements and improved user experience across desktop and mobile devices.

items.name: CareerMatch AI
items.tech: Next.js, TypeScript, FastAPI, Python, LangChain, Groq
description: AI tool that tells candidates whether their profile fits a role before they apply.
Users upload a CV and paste a job description; an LLM pipeline returns a compatibility score, strengths, missing skills, and recommendations.
FastAPI backend with a LangChain prompt chain on Groq and structured JSON output.

items.name: Smart Business Assistant
items.tech: Next.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Python, Flask, Scikit-learn, Groq, Redis, Docker
description: AI-powered all-in-one platform for small and medium businesses to manage products, sales, customers, and an online storefront.
Sales forecasting, anomaly detection, review sentiment analysis, and restock and promotion recommendations.
LLM copilot chatbot, multi-tenant organizations with role-based access, and a trilingual interface (EN, FR, AR).

items.name: Smart RAG
items.tech: React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Groq, JWT
description: Full-stack Retrieval-Augmented Generation app that lets users chat with their own PDF documents.
PDF parsing, chunking, embeddings, and semantic search, with answers grounded in the most relevant passages.
LLM security judge that blocks prompt-injection, jailbreak, and off-topic requests, plus conversation memory.

items.description: Professional bachelor's degree in Software Development with an emphasis on full stack technologies. Learning through real-world projects and gaining strong skills in frontend, backend, and databases, as well as AI and data: machine learning, data analysis (Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn), LLMs, and RAG.

items.institution: Abdelmalek Essaadi University, Tangier - B.A. in Human Resources Management
items.description: Building expertise in organizational behavior, talent management, and leadership strategy. This program enriches my technical background with essential human-centric and collaboration skills.
Earned with honors, specializing in Life and Earth Sciences.
